description: This Java class defines a ProductAttributeEntity which extends ProductAttribute and implements Serializable. It manages product attribute properties such as price, weight, sort order, and default status within a product catalog context.

classes.name: ProductAttributeEntity
classes.description: Represents a configurable product attribute including price, weight, order, and default status.

methods.name: setProductAttributePrice
methods.description: Sets the price associated with this product attribute.

methods.name: getProductAttributePrice
methods.description: Returns the price associated with this product attribute.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for this product attribute.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of this product attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight associated with this product attribute.

methods.name: getProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of this product attribute.

methods.name: setAttributeDefault
methods.description: Sets whether this attribute is the default.

methods.name: isAttributeDefault
methods.description: Returns whether this attribute is the default.
